title: Lipschitz homotopy formula and mass bound, conjuncts (10)–(12), for any operators with (PA), (7) and (9)
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; and (LB), the covector-bounds antecedent (exactly the frozen type of the parent's covector-bounds dependency): (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N; (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). Let lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) and cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) be arbitrary families (currents on univ) satisfying (PA) for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, every sequence of C^∞ maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} with ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X and F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and every sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that each η_j equals F_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X: X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω); the parent's conjunct (7) for cyl (for X with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞: spt cyl(X) compact, M(cyl X) < ∞, M(∂ cyl X) < ∞, spt cyl(X) ⊆ {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ spt X}); and the parent's conjunct (9) for cyl (for such X and ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = X(η)). Then the parent's conjuncts (10), (11), (12) hold verbatim: for Λ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, L-Lipschitz H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) for x ∈ spt X, t ∈ [0, 1]: (10) lpush(G, X) − lpush(F, X) = ∂ lpush(H, cyl X) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and finite mass; (11) lpush(G, X) − lpush(F, X) − lpush(H, cyl ∂X) = ∂ lpush(H, cyl X) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞; (12) M(lpush(H, cyl X)) ≤ ofReal δ·(2Λ)^k·M(X) for X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and δ ∈ ℝ with |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X.
